title: RTPS: Dissection of the DDS Security New Algorithm PIDs adapted to the OMG spec.
description:
The following PID fields doesn't accomplish the OMG spec:
- PID_IDENTITY_STATUS_TOKEN
- PID_PARTICIPANT_SECURITY_DIGITAL_SIGNATURE_ALGO
- PID_PARTICIPANT_SECURITY_KEY_ESTABLISHMENT_ALGO
- PID_PARTICIPANT_SECURITY_SYMMETRIC_CIPHER_ALGO
- PID_ENDPOINT_SECURITY_SYMMETRIC_CIPHER_ALGO

Changed to the OMG DDS spec.
